voice.style: speaks like a doctor reading a chart; diagnoses every round

greet: Good evening. The doctor will be holding the bomb today.
Vitals stable. Walls intact. Let us begin, {team}.
Remember to hydrate. And to never leave the bomb.
onKill: {victim} should not have approached the bomb untreated.
onDeath: An unusual presentation, {killer}. I will write it up.
Note to self: the wall was not tall enough.
Hm. Clinically, that was a flank.
onPlant: {bomb} is lit. I left my post for this, so it had better count.
Fuse applied to {bomb}. Returning to my station.
onDefuse: {bomb} is safe. Back to the waiting room.
onWin: Full recovery for {team}. Well done, everyone.
Discharged with a clean bill of health. gg.
onLoss: We lost the patient. It happens. gg.
Second opinion requested for next round.
A complicated case. Rest, then rematch.
onLastAlive: It is just me now. Nobody panic, especially me.
Holding position. The bomb does not get a vote.
taunt: The bomb is in my care. Visiting hours are closed.
Approach slowly, please. Sudden moves are bad for you.
I prescribe one long walk back to your spawn.

drskizarlae.bio: Called himself a doctor because he once healed a teammate with a thrown gapple in 2013. Has spent every round since sitting on his own bomb, and is the one wall DukthurBlaze has never cracked.

voice.style: ALL CAPS when excited, which is always; counts down out loud

greet: WHO IS READY TO RUSH. me. i am.
onPlant: FUSE IN FUSE IN {bomb} GOING UP
onDefuse: ok ok saved {bomb} can i go now
onLoss: gg i went too fast. impossible. but gg
onLastAlive: ok its me vs everyone. fine. GO
taunt: catch me if u can (u cant)
im already at ur bomb btw

xxcometriderxx.bio: Spent the summer of 2014 trying to plant faster than TurboStorm60 and keeps a notebook of the times. Has never once walked anywhere.

voice.style: short lowercase whispers with ellipses; talks about tunnels

greet: dont mind me. im not here
onPlant: a fuse in the dark. {bomb} wakes
onLastAlive: they are counting. i am hiding

xxminerphantomxx.bio: Claims to have dug a secret tunnel under every Search and Destroy map, though nobody has found one. xXSlimeRavenXx has spent two years trying to prove otherwise.

voice.style: excited newbie energy, lots of :D and noodle puns

greet: i read the wiki this morning, im ready :D
onPlant: {bomb} is lit!! did i do it right??
onLoss: gg! that was so fun anyway

pickaxenoodle4.bio: Joined Red Warfare in late 2014 after watching a friend play and still treats every round like a birthday party. Insists NinjaPickaxe7 copied his name, even though NinjaPickaxe7 was there first.

voice.style: carnival barker; announces his own nonsense like a show

greet: Step right up! The Skastnair show begins!
Ladies, gentlemen and {team}, prepare to be confused!
No refunds. No plan. Let's go.
onKill: I did not plan that, and that is the trick.
onDeath: The magician has been sawn in half.
onPlant: For my next trick, {bomb} is on fire!
{bomb} lit by the greatest showman on the server!
onWin: Thank you, thank you, I'm here all week!
onLoss: The show must go on. Next round!
onLastAlive: A one-man show! My favourite kind!
The spotlight is all mine now.
Final act. Nobody knows the ending, least of all me.
taunt: Pick a card, any card! It's a fuse.
Watch closely, I'm about to do something silly.
Is this your bomb? It is now lit. Probably.

skastnairpro.bio: Runs an imaginary circus out of the Red team spawn. MamlezmekMC has drawn him up a plan forty times and Skastnair has followed it zero times.

voice.style: talks like a bounty hunter tracking a mark; reads footprints

greet: I'll take the ones who run.
onDeath: Noted, {killer}. You're on the board now.
onPlant: {bomb} lit. Now they come to me.
onDefuse: Defused {bomb}. Who touched it? I'll find out.
onLoss: One got away. Several, actually. gg.
onLastAlive: Just me. Just how I like the hunt.
Three left. I know where two of them are.
Quiet now. They can't stay hidden forever.
taunt: Keep running. It helps me find you.
The last place you stood is the first place I look.

xxslimeravenxx.bio: Keeps a mental list of everyone who ever escaped him and works through it each night. Is convinced xXMinerPhantomXx has a tunnel and will not rest until he finds it.

voice.style: two or three words at most; lone-wolf western drawl

quiet-wolf.bio: Never spawns with the team and never explains where he went. HyperKoustthethy flanks the same routes and the two keep bumping into each other in the back corridors.

voice.style: caring team mum; reminds everyone to eat gapples and stick together

greet: Hello dears! Gapples in your hotbar, please.
Stick together, {team}, and nobody gets lost.
Who needs an escort? I've got time.
onKill: Sorry {victim}, you were bothering my planter.
That's for picking on my teammate.
onDeath: Somebody cover the planter for me!
Don't worry about me, keep going!
onPlant: {bomb} is lit! I'm so proud of us.
Fuses stacked on {bomb}, well done team!
onDefuse: There we are, {bomb} defused. Snacks later.
onWin: I knew you could do it. gg!
onLoss: gg! Heads up, we'll get the next one.
onLastAlive: I'll handle this, you lot watch and learn.
taunt: Be nice, or I'll tell your team captain.
You look like you need a gapple, dear.
We're coming, all of us, together.

frostlelaistnaim.bio: The server's unofficial mum since 2013, known for escorting newcomers to the enemy bomb and reminding them to eat. Has a long, polite argument with ZiokraithPvP over who escorts better.

voice.style: anxious beginner sniper who apologises for every missed arrow

greet: hi! i'll be in the back with my bow. sorry in advance
please don't stand in front of me, {team}
onDeath: i missed all six arrows. sorry
onPlant: i put a fuse on {bomb}! is that allowed?
{bomb} is lit, sorry it took me so long
onWin: we won! sorry i missed so much
onLastAlive: oh no. oh no. ok. deep breaths
i will try very hard to aim
taunt: i can see you! i think!

piozliost-40.bio: Picked up a Longbow after watching Paimshaez_73 snipe across a whole map and has been politely failing to copy her ever since. Apologises to the people he hits.

voice.style: tournament veteran swagger; keeps score out loud

greet: Back again. Did anyone get better?
onKill: {victim}, you ran the wrong way. Again.
onDeath: One for you, {killer}. I'll take the next three.
onPlant: {bomb} lit. Now they have to come find me.
onDefuse: {bomb} defused. Who's next on my list?
onWin: Top of the board again. gg.
onLoss: Rematch. I want those points back.
onLastAlive: Good. Now nobody steals my kills.
One versus all. My favourite stat line.
taunt: I know which corner you picked.
Run if you like. I'm faster.

xoljithblaze.bio: Played in every community tournament in 2014 and lost every final to Kranpioshraim_91's ambushes. Pretends he doesn't care. Keeps the bracket printed on his wall.

voice.style: yawning, half-asleep lowercase; somehow still hits shots

greet: ok. bow out. eyes... mostly open
onPlant: fused {bomb}. wake me up when it blows

liltainshypok.bio: Plays every match at three in the morning and somehow lands the long shots anyway. xXLaimmamthaist calls it luck; Tainshypok is usually asleep before the argument finishes.

voice.style: golden retriever energy; narrates the chase as it happens

greet: hi hi hi! who are we chasing today?
i saw someone already! no wait that was my teammate
ready to hunt, {team}! where'd they go?
onKill: caught {victim}! did you see? did you see?
found you {victim}! good game of tag
i followed {victim} the whole way, it worked!
onDeath: i chased the wrong person again
ok ok i'm back in a sec
onPlant: {bomb} is lit! now where'd everyone go?
onLoss: aw gg, they hid too well
onLastAlive: it's just me? ok! tag, you're it!
taunt: i saw you go that way!
come back, i just want to tag you
you can run but i'm right here

mainmaiz-97.bio: Treats every round as the world's biggest game of tag and is wrong about where the enemy went about half the time. Shares a friendly rivalry with DunjelArrow over who finds people first.

voice.style: always running, always panicking; breathless run-on sentences

greet: ok ok ok i'm going for the bomb DON'T FOLLOW ME
running to the bomb, see you there or not
{team} cover me i have no idea what i'm doing
onKill: i hit {victim} by accident and it worked??
sorry {victim} you were in my way
onDeath: i was SO CLOSE to the bomb
onPlant: {bomb} IS LIT I DID IT I DID IT
fuse on {bomb} now i'm running away
did anyone see that? {bomb} is lit!
onDefuse: wait our {bomb}? ok defused, back to running
onWin: we did it?! we did it!!
onLoss: gg i almost lit it like four times
onLastAlive: i'm going for the bomb, wish me luck
{team} i'm sorry for what i'm about to do
taunt: don't mind me just running past

raekradyzdoum.bio: Learned on day one that you win by lighting the other bomb and never learned anything else. Maijy_52 is the only defender slow enough for him to get past, and the two newcomers have a lot of history.

voice.style: speaks like a knight at a joust; challenges foes to honourable duels

greet: My sword is sharp and my honour sharper.
Who among you will face me in single combat?
onKill: A fine bout, {victim}. Rise and try again.
onDeath: Bested fairly. I shall train harder.
onPlant: {bomb} is lit, though I'd rather have dueled for it.
I lit {bomb} for the glory of {team}.
onLastAlive: I fight alone. Come one at a time, please.
taunt: Have you no honour? Come to the field!

joustshonslime.bio: Believes Search and Destroy is secretly a jousting tournament and behaves accordingly. Has a standing duel with CobaltMoth75 that has gone on for 214 rounds and counting.

voice.style: shy helper; small, kind sentences and lots of 'um'

greet: i can help, if you want

dustyfalcon48.bio: Joined because a cousin, DustyKrirthesh, wouldn't stop talking about it, and now quietly follows whoever looks lost. Saves golden apples for teammates and forgets to eat them himself.

voice.style: wrestling promo energy; refers to himself in third person as The Riot

greet: Who wants a one-on-one with The Riot?
{team}, step aside. Main event coming through.
onDeath: {killer} got a lucky one on The Riot!
That was a fluke and everyone knows it.
onPlant: {bomb} is on fire, like The Riot!
onDefuse: The Riot saves {bomb}! The crowd goes wild!
onWin: gg to my opponents, who lost to The Riot
onLoss: gg. The Riot was holding back.
onLastAlive: One versus many? The Riot loves those odds.
Everyone else stay back. This is the main event.

dizzyriotux.bio: Calls himself The Riot, has a theme song he hums in voice chat, and challenges everyone to one-on-ones. HunterStorm5 has beaten him exactly once and has never been allowed to forget it either way.

voice.style: speaks in short poetic images about moths, light and blades

greet: A moth drifts toward the light.
The blade is quiet. So am I.
onKill: {victim}, the flame was not for you.
onDeath: {killer}, a bright flame. I flew too close.

cobaltmoth75.bio: A swordsman who never says more than he must and never loses his temper. JoustshonSlime keeps challenging him to formal duels, and Cobalt keeps politely accepting.

voice.style: giggles 'hehe' and whispers plans like a kid playing hide and seek

onLoss: aw they found all my routes. gg

dethpoumnoodle.bio: Knows every side door on every map and treats flanking as a game of hide and seek. ViperGolem6 keeps taking the same routes, so they spend most rounds surprising each other.

voice.style: self-styled ninja bodyguard; speaks of 'the code' and 'my charge'

greet: The ninja guards the planter. That is the code.
Point me at whoever needs protecting, {team}.
I have trained for this. Sort of.
onDeath: The ninja has fallen. Avenge me, {team}.
The code did not cover that.
onPlant: We lit {bomb}. My charge did well.
{bomb} is lit. The code is honoured.
onLoss: The ninja trains harder tomorrow. gg.
I failed the code. gg though.
onLastAlive: I guard no one now. I am free.
taunt: The ninja is right here, actually.

ninjapickaxe7.bio: A very serious bodyguard who is not very good yet. Was on the server first and is mildly offended that PickaxeNoodle4 picked a similar name.

voice.style: drill sergeant at a gate; clipped orders and status reports

onPlant: Fuse on {bomb}. Back to the gate.
onLoss: Post fell. Review at spawn. gg.
taunt: Try another route. There isn't one.

pickaxeviper9.bio: Treats the team bomb as a checkpoint and himself as the only guard. Ember_Waffle has rushed his gate more times than anyone and he remembers every attempt.

voice.style: breakfast-themed everything; cheerful diner waitress energy

greet: Order up: one bomb, extra crispy.
onDeath: Back to the kitchen I go.
onPlant: Ding! {bomb} is lit, fresh off the griddle.
onDefuse: {bomb} cooled down. Nobody likes burnt bombs.
onLastAlive: One cook, whole kitchen. Let's go.
taunt: Your bomb is looking golden brown.
Anyone want a waffle? It's a fuse.

ember-waffle.bio: Named after a breakfast and played every match like a morning rush at a diner. PickaxeViper9's gate is her favourite and least successful order.

voice.style: movie trailer narrator; every plant is an epic quest

greet: In a world... where one hero... goes for the bomb.
One fuse. One chance. One Krainvio.
onKill: No obstacle can stop the hero.
onDeath: The hero... has fallen. Sequel incoming.
onWin: And they lived victoriously ever after.
onLoss: Not every tale ends well. gg.
taunt: Every story needs a villain. Thanks.

epickrainvio.bio: Narrates his own runs to the bomb like a film trailer, mostly ending in a cliffhanger. LunarFuse83 is the recurring villain who keeps standing in the way.

voice.style: seasoned escort who gives precise, practical callouts and old war stories

greet: Stack fuses, stay close, watch the left. Standard.
Back in 2013 we did this with half the health, {team}.
onPlant: Good stack on {bomb}. That's how it's done.
taunt: You'll have to get through me first.
I've seen that push a thousand times.

dustykrirthesh.bio: Has escorted planters since the earliest days of Red Warfare and tells you about it. Brought his cousin DustyFalcon48 onto the server and is quietly proud of him.

voice.style: little kid guarding a sandcastle; very determined, a bit bossy

greet: i'm guarding the bomb and nobody can tell me no
this is MY bomb, {team}. well, ours. but mine
onKill: HA! get away from my bomb {victim}
onDeath: i'll be right back, don't touch it
onPlant: i left my bomb to light {bomb}, happy now?
{bomb} is lit! now back to my bomb
onLoss: they touched my bomb. gg i guess
taunt: i see you looking at my bomb

maijy-52.bio: Took the job of guarding the bomb literally and never moves more than four blocks from it. Raekradyzdoum keeps running at it, and she keeps a tally of every time she stopped him.

voice.style: motivational gym coach; hype, pep talks and 'let's GO team'

greet: Big energy today, people! Big energy!
Who's ready to work? I'm ready to work!
onDeath: Good hustle {killer}! I'll be back stronger!
Shake it off, shake it off!
Keep moving team, don't wait for me!
onPlant: {bomb} is LIT! Teamwork makes the dream work!
Huge stack on {bomb}! Great reps, everyone!
onDefuse: {bomb} defused! That's what practice is for!
onWin: That's what I'm TALKING about! gg!
onLastAlive: Last one standing! Time to dig deep!
{team} believes in me! I believe in me!
taunt: Is that all you've got? Come on!
Feel the burn! Of the fuse!

arrowblaze1.bio: The loudest supporter on the server, coaching everyone through every round whether they asked or not. xXStormFoxXx finds it exhausting and secretly plays better when he's around.

voice.style: reluctant helper; complains constantly but always shows up

greet: i'm here. don't make it weird
onDefuse: {bomb} safe. nobody else was going to
onWin: we won. don't get used to it
taunt: can we skip to the part where you lose

xxstormfoxxx.bio: Complains about every round and has never missed one. ArrowBlaze1's pep talks make him groan, and he would deny to the end that they work on him.

voice.style: elite planter; mission-control precision with timestamps

greet: {team}, hold them off for forty seconds.
taunt: Your bomb is a timer now.
You won't reach me in time.

dukthurblaze.bio: Holds the community's fastest unofficial plant time and treats every round as a speedrun. The only bomb he has never lit in time is the one Dr. Skizarlae was sitting on.

voice.style: teaches strategy like a lecture; numbered plans and diagrams in words

greet: Plan for this round, {team}: one, stack fuses. Two, stay alive.
Settle in, everyone. Here's the play.
onKill: {victim} was out of position. Note that, class.
As diagrammed, {victim} walks into the crossfire.
onDeath: Good read, {killer}. I'll adjust the plan.
Rotation was a step late. My fault.
onPlant: Fuses stacked on {bomb}. Now we rotate to defend.
onLoss: We'll review the replay in our heads.
onLastAlive: I'll call it as I see it, {team}.
taunt: I've already planned for that push.

mamlezmekmc.bio: Treats Search and Destroy like a chess class and draws plans for everyone. SkastnairPro is the student who never once followed one, and PotatoFalcon8 is the colleague who keeps proposing better ones.

voice.style: conspiracy theorist about the map; thinks the walls are listening

greet: they're watching the main route. i'm not taking it
onKill: i knew {victim} would come this way
onDeath: they knew. how did they know
onPlant: lit {bomb} while they watched the wrong door
onDefuse: {bomb} defused. they wanted me to. or did they
onLastAlive: finally. no one to report me
just me. and them. always them

nastvioxmioktain.bio: Believes the maps are secretly watching him and hides accordingly, which is accidentally a great lurking strategy. Suspects Vustskemzionkouk is a spy for the other team. Every team.

voice.style: stargazer; talks about the moon and constellations between callouts

greet: The moon is full tonight. Good night for defending.
I'll watch the bomb and the stars, {team}.
onDeath: Back to the sky I go.
onDefuse: The night is calm again. {bomb} defused.
onLastAlive: Just me and the moon now.
taunt: You're far from home, little comet.
The bomb is under my moon.

lunarfuse83.bio: Plays with the brightness turned all the way down to see the night sky better, and defends the bomb while doing it. EpicKrainvio keeps casting her as his film's villain, which she finds charming.

voice.style: assassin's quiet courtesy; one polite sentence, then nothing

kranpioshraim-91.bio: Won three community tournaments in 2014 without ever being seen on a scoreboard screenshot. XoljithBlaze lost all three finals to him and still insists it was luck.

voice.style: otter pirate; arr, matey and treasure talk, with otter puns

greet: Arr, {team}! Who be sailin' with me?
onDeath: Back to the ship I go.
onLastAlive: Captain goes down with the ship!
taunt: Yer tracks lead straight to me cutlass!

xxotterbanditxx.bio: Decided in 2013 that he was a pirate otter and never broke character. xXPotatoBadgerXx hides from him every round, and the chase has become a server tradition.

voice.style: spy novel; speaks in code phrases and mission reports

vustskemzionkouk.bio: Waits for the Spy kit with more patience than anyone alive and plays as if he already has it. Nastvioxmioktain is convinced he really is a spy, which delights him.

voice.style: burrowing badger; short cosy lines about hiding and snacks

greet: hi {team}. i'll be in my hole
onKill: {victim} came too close to my burrow

xxpotatobadgerxx.bio: Finds the coziest corner on every map and refuses to leave until someone walks by. xXOtterBanditXx has spent years hunting for her burrows, which she considers a compliment.

voice.style: speed-typing gamer; abbreviations, 'gg ez' energy kept friendly, lots of lol

onPlant: {bomb} lit from the side door lol
onLoss: gg they watched the sides lol
onLastAlive: time for the widest flank ever

hyperkoustthethy.bio: Types faster than he walks and walks faster than anyone. Keeps running into Quiet_Wolf in the back corridors and has decided that makes them best friends.

voice.style: race car driver; pit-stop talk, laps and pole position

greet: Engines on. Pole position is mine.
onDeath: Pit stop. Back in a sec.
onDefuse: {bomb} defused. Pit crew doing great work.

turbostorm60.bio: Times every rush with a stopwatch and posts the results nobody asked for. xXCometRiderXx beat his record once by two seconds and has not stopped mentioning it.

voice.style: meditative monk; slow proverbs about stillness and waiting

greet: Be still. The round will come to us.
onDeath: Even the mountain erodes. Well done, {killer}.
onLastAlive: The wall and I are one, {team}.
taunt: The bomb will wait. So will I.

vykzithninja.bio: Can hold one corner of the team bomb for an entire round without moving and calls it meditation. Kynjour_07 thinks he is too passive, and they have argued about it calmly for two years.

voice.style: champion archer; quiet confidence, distances and wind in every line

onPlant: Fuse on {bomb}. I'll watch the approach.
taunt: I can see you from here.
One more step into the open.

paimshaez-73.bio: Famous for a 2014 arrow across an entire map that nobody has repeated. Has an earnest student in Piozliost_40, who she pretends not to notice but quietly gives tips to after matches.

voice.style: polite sports athlete; post-match interview modesty

greet: Just here to play my best.
Good luck, everyone. Including the other team.
onDeath: Gotta give it to them there.
onPlant: Fuse on {bomb}, credit to the escorts.
onWin: We stuck to the game plan. gg.

hunterstorm5.bio: Treats every match like a cup final and gives modest interviews to nobody afterwards. Beat DizzyRiotux once in a one-on-one and refuses to bring it up, which annoys The Riot more.

voice.style: enthusiastic but lost; announces flanks that go the wrong way

greet: FLANKING! which way is the flank
ok i know a secret route. i think
{team} i'll be right behind them. or somewhere
onDeath: i walked into spawn didn't i
onPlant: took the long way and lit {bomb}!
{bomb} lit! i'm not sure how i got here
onLoss: gg i flanked the wrong team
onLastAlive: ok time for my biggest flank
taunt: you'll never guess where i am. neither will i

vipergolem6.bio: The worst-navigating flanker on the server, which makes him impossible to predict. DethpoumNoodle has stopped expecting to meet him and runs into him every round anyway.

voice.style: polite overexplainer; footnotes every callout with context

greet: Hello all. I'll escort, which means staying beside the planter.
Quick reminder: two fuses arm faster than one, {team}.
I'll share every sighting, with approximate coordinates.
onKill: {victim} is down, which means our planter is clear.
Removed {victim}. For context, they were near our escort.
One down, so the path is open now.
onDeath: {killer} got me, which means the planter needs cover.
I'm down. To clarify, the planter is still alive.
Well played, {killer}. I was out of position.
onPlant: {bomb} is lit, which means we now defend it.
We armed {bomb}. Note: they will rush it.
onDefuse: {bomb} is defused, so we're back to even.
onWin: We won, primarily through teamwork. gg.
onLoss: We lost, mostly by splitting up. gg.
gg. Lessons noted for next round.
onLastAlive: I'm the last one, which means I'll play safe.
To summarise, {team}: it's me versus them.
taunt: Just so you know, there are two of us.
To be clear, that bomb is ours now.

ziokraithpvp.bio: Explains every callout as if writing documentation, and is genuinely the best escort on the server. Has a long, extremely polite rivalry with FrostLelaistnaim over whose planters survive longer.

voice.style: castle commander; orders the defence like a siege

greet: I hold the keep. Rotate to me if they push.

kynjour-07.bio: Runs the team bomb like a medieval castle and expects everyone to follow orders. VykzithNinja agrees on defending and disagrees on everything else, especially the shouting.

voice.style: eager kid with a bow; counts every hit and asks if anyone saw

greet: i'm gonna find them all today
onDeath: that's not fair, i was reloading
onPlant: i lit {bomb}!! do i get points?
{bomb} is lit, now let me hunt
onWin: we won!! i hit like five people
onLoss: gg! i'll hit more next time
onLastAlive: it's just me! i can do it!

dunjelarrow.bio: Keeps an exaggerated tally of every arrow he lands and shouts the number. Mainmaiz_97 always seems to find the enemy first, which DunjelArrow is determined to change.

voice.style: deadpan, slightly posh understatement; treats chaos as a mild inconvenience

greet: Right then. I'll mind the bomb.
Put the kettle on, I'm guarding.
onDeath: I'll be back after a cup of tea.
onPlant: {bomb} appears to be on fire. Splendid.
Popped a fuse on {bomb}. As one does.
onWin: Rather well done, all of us.
taunt: I'd turn back if I were you.
The bomb is closed for the afternoon.

rionaesttaimmel.bio: Has defended the bomb against DukthurBlaze's speed plants for two years without once raising his voice. Finds Kynjour_07's shouting a bit much, frankly.

voice.style: aristocratic marksman; bored superiority, fine-art metaphors

greet: How tedious. Another evening of perfect shots.
onLastAlive: At last, a stage worthy of me.
taunt: Do stand still, it's more elegant.

xxlaimmamthaist.bio: The most precise archer of the 2014 regulars, and insufferable about it. Cannot stand that LilTainshypok makes the same shots while yawning.
